description: Text-to-image generation with FLUX.2 [dev] from Black Forest Labs. Enhanced realism, crisper text generation, and native editing capabilities—all at turbo speed.

input_params.name: seed
input_params.description: The seed to use for the generation. If not provided, a random seed will be used.

input_params.name: enable_safety_checker
input_params.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked, and images flagged as unsafe are returned as black images.

input_params.name: prompt
input_params.description: The prompt to generate an image from.

input_params.name: num_images
input_params.description: The number of images to generate.

input_params.name: output_format
input_params.description: The format of the generated image.

input_params.name: guidance_scale
input_params.description: Guidance Scale is a measure of how close you want the model to stick to your prompt when looking for a related image to show you.

input_params.name: image_size
input_params.description: The size of the image to generate. The width and height must be between 512 and 2048 pixels.

input_params.name: sync_mode
input_params.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

input_params.name: enable_prompt_expansion
input_params.description: If set to true, the prompt will be expanded for better results.

output_fields.name: seed
output_fields.description:
Seed of the generated Image. It will be the same value of the one passed in the
            input or the randomly generated that was used in case none was passed.

output_fields.name: prompt
output_fields.description: The prompt used for generating the image.

output_fields.name: has_nsfw_concepts
output_fields.description: Whether the generated images contain NSFW concepts.
